patients.summary: Software engineer who joined in 2019 healthy; beta thalassemia minor found after a workplace CBC in 2023, then ankylosing spondylitis with recurrent anterior uveitis in 2024, managed by outside rheumatology on adalimumab and sulfasalazine with progressive symptoms by 2026.

documents.title: New patient enrollment call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
New patient inquiry by phone. Caller wants to join the practice for primary care. Insurance: Blue Cross PPO, card copy to come by email. Membership agreement and intake forms emailed to min-jun.burgos@example.test.
Signed release received back during the call for his prior primary care office; records request faxed 2:20 pm.
New patient physical scheduled Tue 9/10 at 9:00 with PCP. Reminded him to bring any vaccine records he has.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT — PREVENTIVE VISIT

23-year-old man establishing care. Last physical was about three years ago at his old office. No concerns today; mostly wants a doctor he can reach.

PMH: none. PSH: none. Never hospitalized.
Meds: none, no supplements.
Allergies: NKDA.
FH: father has ankylosing spondylitis, told he is HLA-B27 positive. Paternal uncle with Crohn's disease. Otherwise nothing he knows of.
SH: software engineer. Single, lives in South Hadley. Never a smoker, no alcohol, no drugs. Works out most days of the week.

ROS: negative across systems, including no back pain or stiffness, eye problems, bowel changes or rashes.

EXAM
Vitals on flowsheet, all normal. BMI in normal range.
Well, pleasant. HEENT unremarkable, conjunctivae clear. Neck supple, no adenopathy, thyroid not enlarged. Heart regular rate and rhythm, no murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abdomen soft, nontender, no organomegaly. Spine straight, nontender, full forward flexion. Skin clear. Neuro grossly nonfocal.

PHQ-2: 0.

ASSESSMENT / PLAN
Healthy young adult, preventive visit.
- Tdap given today; the last tetanus shot he remembers was in middle school.
- Fasting lipids, CMP, HIV and hepatitis C screening drawn today.
- Old records requested 8/28; will reconcile childhood vaccines when they arrive.
- Flu vaccine at a nurse visit once this season's supply is in.
- Family history noted.

Next physical in a year. Knows he can text or call the practice directly.

documents.title: Your physical labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hi Min-jun,

Everything from Tuesday is back and in good shape. Cholesterol numbers are healthy, kidney and liver tests and blood sugar are normal, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. I'll see you next fall, or sooner if anything comes up.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: outside primary care
documents.body:
Records received by fax, 11 pages (prior primary care office; covers 2003 to 2016).

Problem list: none.
Medications: none.
Allergies: NKDA.
Surgical history: none.
Last well visit 2016: normal exam, no concerns.

Immunization history:
- Hepatitis B, three-dose infant series
- DTaP five doses; Tdap 2008
- IPV four doses
- Hib and pneumococcal conjugate infant series
- MMR two doses
- Varicella two doses
- Meningococcal conjugate two doses
- HPV three doses, completed 2010
- Hepatitis A two doses

Reviewed by PCP 9/24: childhood series complete. Scanned to chart.

documents.title: Influenza vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body:
Here for seasonal flu vaccine. Feels well today, no fever. No history of reaction to vaccines, no egg allergy.
Quadrivalent influenza 0.5 mL IM, left deltoid. VIS provided. Waited 15 min, no reaction. Left ambulatory.

documents.title: Membership renewal
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Annual membership renewal processed; pt confirmed address and phone unchanged. Blue Cross PPO card on file still current. Reminded him his physical is due in the fall.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL

24 y/o M, healthy. No interval illness. Masked visit. Says the year has been quiet; still exercising, running outdoors more.
Meds none. NKDA. FH unchanged (father AS, paternal uncle Crohn's). Never smoker, no ETOH.

ROS neg — no fatigue, back pain, eye redness, GI change, rash.

Exam: vitals fine. Well appearing. Eyes clear. Neck no nodes. RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd benign. Back nontender. Skin clear.
PHQ-2 0.

Plan: flu shot today. No labs needed this year. Return next fall.

documents.title: Vaccine card
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, attaching a photo of my COVID vaccine card — both Pfizer doses done at the pharmacy, 4/12 and 5/3. Second one knocked me out for a day but I'm fine now. Can you add it to my chart?

documents.title: RE: Vaccine card
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Got it, thank you! Both doses are entered in your record now and match the state registry.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical — 25M

Doing well. Fully vaccinated for COVID in the spring. No complaints. Exercise: lifting and running, about four times a week.
Meds: none. Allergies: NKDA.
Social: never smoker, no alcohol, no drugs.

ROS: negative.
Exam: normal vitals. NAD. Conjunctivae clear, no injection. Neck supple. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Spine nontender, normal motion. Skin without rash.
PHQ-2: 0.

A/P: healthy. Flu vaccine given. COVID booster when he becomes eligible. Back in a year.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL — 26 y/o man

Rescheduled from September. Feels great, no concerns. Still working out four days a week. Diet varied.
No meds. NKDA. Never smoked, doesn't drink.

ROS: no fatigue, no exertional symptoms, no back or joint pain, no eye trouble, no GI symptoms.

Exam: vitals WNL. Well. HEENT normal. Neck supple, no thyromegaly. Heart RRR. Lungs CTA. Abdomen soft, no HSM. Back and joints normal. Skin normal.
PHQ-2 0.

Plan: flu today, bivalent COVID booster at the pharmacy. Lipids and screening labs were normal in 2019; nothing due. RTC 1 yr.
